title: DEMO_BRANCHED_HELPERS are skipped unconditionally - an unguarded api call inside any of the 8 listed fns passes the lint, contradicting the script's own 'verified by the arm scan' comment
evidence:
# Helpers whose api calls are demo-safe: every entry contains a real
# `case model.demo_mode` branch (verified by the arm scan like any other
# scope — they are listed here only so their fn-scoped calls skip the
# message-manifest path).
...
        if scope_name.startswith("<fn:") and scope_name[4:-1] in DEMO_BRANCHED_HELPERS:
            continue
PROBE (run in worktree): inserted `  let _probe = vacancy_api.list_vacancies(ApiReturnedDashboardData)` as the first line inside `fn save_refcheck_edit(` in a synthetic copy of client.gleam; `python3 scripts/lint_demo_network.py --client <copy>` exited 0 ("demo no-network lint clean").
detail: The helpers branch skips the guard check entirely (bare continue), so any future unguarded api call added to submit_vacancy/save_refcheck_edit/etc. is invisible to the no-network lint. The 'verified by the arm scan' claim is false in code. No live violation today.
recommended_fix: For DEMO_BRANCHED_HELPERS scopes, still run demo_guard_in_same_scope (fn-bounded) instead of an unconditional continue, and add a bite-test injecting an unguarded call into a listed helper.

title: demo_guard_in_same_scope is a textual substring match: a let-bound expression `case model.demo_mode` or an in-arm comment containing 'model.demo_mode' both satisfy a later unguarded api call in the same arm
detail: Two verified false-negative shapes in the no-network pillar's enforcement: guard-as-expression does not bound subsequent calls, and comment text counts as a guard. Neither shape is covered by the three bite-tests. No live violation in the shipped tree (lint + greps green).
recommended_fix: Skip comment lines before the substring check, and require the guard to be a statement-position `case ... demo_mode {` whose False arm textually contains the call; add both probe shapes to lint_demo_network_bite_test.py.

title: still present since round 3: entering demo clobbers a live landlord session; exit downgrades auth to NotAsked
evidence:
client.gleam enter_demo:
        Model(
          ..model,
          route:,
          auth: Success(landlord),
          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",
          demo_mode: True,
model.gleam clear_demo_state:
    demo_mode: False,
    demo_store: None,
    auth: NotAsked,
detail: Verified unchanged: a logged-in landlord opening /demo has auth overwritten with the mock landlord, and demo exit sets auth to NotAsked - they must re-auth client-side even though their session cookie is intact.
recommended_fix: Preserve the pre-demo auth on the model and restore it on exit (or re-check session on exit), instead of forcing NotAsked.

vs main():
